title: Database MCQ assignment with LLM-guided reflection
summary: Students answer multiple-choice questions about database locking protocols with access to a GPT-3 tutor. Half then spend at least five minutes reflecting with an LLM before a related proctored exam two weeks later.

sources.title: Supporting Self-Reflection at Scale with Large Language Models: Insights from Randomized Field Experiments in Classrooms
sources.evidence_quote: multiple MCQ questions on the topic of locking protocols

assessment.summary: Answer database concurrency MCQs and optionally complete guided post-assignment reflection.
student_actions: Solve locking-protocol MCQs with an LLM tutor.
Discuss understanding, confidence, and misconceptions with a reflection bot when assigned.
Later answer similar questions in a proctored exam.

student_role.description: GPT-3 supported all students on the assignment and guided post-assignment reflection for the treatment group.

grading.method: Assignment and later proctored-exam scores were analyzed; detailed course weighting was not reported.

related_assessments.description: Distinct assessment reported in the same source.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: 145 of 218 students completed the assignment and were randomized; exam differences were not statistically significant, while reflection-group confidence increased modestly.
